data.one_liner: A Dart library for implementing instrument tuning apps.
data.what_it_does: It evaluates audio pitches against expected instrument note frequencies to determine tuning status. Currently, it supports guitar tuning and calculates differences in frequency and cents.
use_when: You are building an instrument tuning application in Dart or Flutter.
You need to check if a given pitch matches a guitar note and whether it is too high or too low.
avoid_when: You need support for instruments other than the guitar.
You need general-purpose audio recording or playback features.
strengths: Simple and straightforward API for evaluating pitches.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited instrument support, currently restricted to guitars only.
Minimal documentation and features beyond basic pitch evaluation.
data.minimal_example:
final pitchUp = PitchHandler(InstrumentType.guitar);
final handledPitchResult = await pitchUp.handlePitch(pitch);
